name: notch-fight
description: Plays the Notch Fight clips in a band above the prompt while Claude works

display.title: Display
display.description: image: the real PNG frames (kitty, Ghostty), falls back to raster elsewhere. Where image does not work: octant (recommended: 2x4-pixel cells, native resolution at 16 rows; needs a font with the Unicode 16 octants, e.g. Cascadia Mono, outside kitty/Ghostty/WezTerm), sextant (2x3, no font needed in Orca/VS Code), raster (2x2, any terminal)

rows.title: Height
rows.description: Terminal rows the clip takes (4 to 24); the width follows the clip's shape. Native resolution: octant at 16 rows, sextant at 21

repo.title: notch-fight checkout
repo.description: Where the notch-fight checkout is (its build/clips). Empty: the checkout this plugin is in
